Description

Small business bookkeeping without a subscription: log every sale and cost, see your profit by month, quarter and year, keep your invoices, mileage and quarterly tax set-aside in order, and hand your accountant a Schedule C summary. It opens in any browser and never asks you to sign up for anything.

Small Business Profit Plan is one HTML file. You download it, double-click it, and it opens like a web page. Log a sale or an expense in seconds, or import your bank's CSV and your Etsy, Shopify, PayPal or Stripe statements. From then on it sorts everything into categories and Schedule C lines, shows what the business actually made, how much tax to set aside before each due date, who still owes you, and where the money goes, channel by channel. No bank login, no subscription. Your numbers stay on your own computer.

How It Works:
1. Download the file and save it somewhere you will find it again.
2. Double-click to open it in your browser. Take the short tour, or explore the fictional sample business first.
3. Add your business name and pick your categories. Common ones (product sales, materials, platform fees, software, advertising) are ready.
4. Log sales and costs as they happen, or import your bank CSV and platform statements each month.
5. Check the dashboard, profit & loss and quarterly tax as you go. At tax time, print the Schedule C summary.

WHAT YOU'LL GET:
• One HTML small business bookkeeping file
• Dashboard: revenue, expenses, profit and what's free to use this month
• Income & expense tracker: log in seconds, search, filter by category, channel and tag; bulk edit with Undo
• Import your bank CSV and Etsy, Shopify, PayPal and Stripe statements, with duplicates skipped
• Profit & loss statement by month, quarter, year or your own dates; print or download CSV
• Business health: runway, break-even revenue, gross and net margin, your biggest channel
• Invoices: write them, mark them paid, see what's overdue, send friendly reminders
• Quarterly tax set-aside: what to put aside before each due date, and whether you're ahead
• Schedule C summary: expenses on their IRS lines for your accountant; print or export
• Mileage log with the deduction value at the rate you set
• Sales channels: see what Etsy, Shopify, Amazon, PayPal, Stripe or clients really earn you
• Monthly targets, recurring costs and a calendar
• Annual overview, year over year and cut costs, with what savings add up to
• Every table sorts, searches and filters
• 7 color themes, light and dark; every screen prints
• Built-in how-to guide and a PDF guide included

PERFECT FOR:
Etsy and Shopify sellers, freelancers, consultants, makers and crafters, content creators, side hustles, service businesses and anyone self-employed who files a Schedule C, plus anyone replacing a small business bookkeeping spreadsheet or business expense tracker who wants their numbers to stay private on their own computer.

Please note: this is a digital file, not a physical product. Nothing will be posted to you. It doesn't connect to your bank; you log entries yourself or import CSV downloads (PDF statements can't be read). Your data is stored in your own browser on your own device, and this app never uploads anything anywhere. Download a backup regularly; the app reminds you, and Chrome and Edge can back up to a folder automatically every day. Works best on a computer. The tax screens are worksheets, not tax advice; tax rules differ by country and change every year.
